principles.heading: How I work

ownership.title: From task to production
ownership.body: I take a task from the first discussion to the release.

quality.title: Quality over speed
quality.body: Work done right the first time does not need redoing.

respect.title: Respect for people
respect.body: I have been to more than 45 countries and know how much people and their values differ, so at work understanding and respect come first.

principles.aside: Outside work I keep moving: gym, running, hiking and long walks. I unwind with an audiobook, music, anime or a game, and my cat waits for me at home.
